comment: A RECORDED run, not a CI gate: mutating the tree and running every layer takes minutes and cannot be part of the per-commit gates. What IS gated is the campaign DEFINITION (every anchor still resolves) and this file's internal consistency — see tests/test_generated_docs.py.

mutations.what: harness-honesty control: no mutation at all, which must report zero failing layers
the reference widens the reduction scope to the verdict layer
mutations.rule: reduction: comparing final diagnostics is #260's ACCEPTANCE, blocked by #259 — the scope is a contract, not a parameter

mutations.what: the reference reports the whole step instead of the minimal difference inside it
mutations.rule: reduction: the difference must be MINIMAL — the field, not the step body

mutations.what: the reference stops noticing a step only one engine addresses
mutations.rule: reduction: left-only / right-only are two of the four content classes
caught_by: python::non-zero exit with no FAIL line

mutations.what: the reference stops noticing an ordering-only difference
mutations.rule: reduction: on a layer whose order is declared significant, the sequence IS the difference

mutations.what: the reference compares two engines' refusal TEXTS, manufacturing a divergence out of message vocabulary
mutations.rule: reduction: when both engines refused, compare THAT they refused, never how they phrased it

mutations.what: the reference reports the LAST divergence instead of the first
mutations.rule: reduction: the reducer names the FIRST divergence in pipeline order

mutations.what: the reference stops distinguishing a key-ORDER difference from agreement
mutations.rule: reduction: object key order is significant — the surfaces fix field order byte-exactly

mutations.what: the reference carries the MOS document in `dump_summaries`' insertion order rather than its surface's
mutations.rule: capture: each layer document is carried in the key order its OWN surface fixes

mutations.what: the port widens the reduction scope to the verdict layer
mutations.rule: reduction: the scope is a contract, not a parameter

mutations.what: the port compares two engines' refusal texts instead of the fact that both refused
mutations.rule: reduction: a refusal's text is each engine's own

mutations.what: the port reports the last divergence instead of the first
mutations.rule: reduction: the reducer names the FIRST divergence in pipeline order
